acquisition_method: Data-dependent acquisition mode was used to trigger precursor isolation and sequencing.
alkylation_concentration: Five microliters of IAA solution (30 mM in 50 mM ABC) was dispensed to alkylate sulfhydryl groups
alkylation_reagent: DTT and iodoacetamide (IAA) were purchased from Thermo Scientific
cleavage_agent: Trypsin (MS grade) and Lys-C (MS grade) were products of Promega
collision_energy: fragmented by high energy dissociation with a collision energy of 28%
fragmentation_method: fragmented by high energy dissociation with a collision energy of 28%
ionization_type: Electrospray voltage of 1.9 kV was applied at the source.
labeling: LFQ calculations were performed separately in each parameter group containing similar cell loading.
mass_analyzer: An Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid MS (ThermoFisher) was employed for all data collection.
reduction_concentration: 50-nL RapiGest (0.2%) solution with 10 mM DTT in 50 mM ABC was added to the nanodroplets
reduction_reagent: DTT and iodoacetamide (IAA) were purchased from Thermo Scientific

instrument.evidence: An Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid MS (ThermoFisher) was employed for all data collection.

ptm.evidence: Carbamidomethylation of cysteine residues was set as a fixed modification.
